title: The Clay Thumbprint on the Good Cup
youtube_title: The Clay Thumbprint on the Good Cup | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Telling the truth early makes a small mistake easier to mend.
summary: At a ceramic studio sill above the quiet plaza, Bibi is tangled up with a thumbprint pressed into a cup that was meant to be smooth and almost hides it. Bibi tells Grandpa Sol the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
